name: Flat Adventure
finish: Crisp broad flat colour shapes, selective thin interior strokes, almost no outer outlines. Clean lively graphic silhouettes. No gradients or grain.
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Correct and clean up the attached Kokomonster sheet, retaining its drawing finish. NEW TITLE "A — FLAT ADVENTURE". Exactly two rows x six characters labelled Koko, Gohanko, Bear, Rabbit, Yauyau, Tree. White spacious landscape sheet. Row PLAIN neutral standing. Row WITH PROPS: Koko/book, Gohanko/teacup, Bear/pencil and notebook, Rabbit/map, Yauyau/magnifier in one hand and leaf in other, Tree/watering can and sprout. Crisp broad flat colour shapes, selective thin interior strokes, almost no outer outlines. Clean lively graphic silhouettes. No gradients or grain.
CRITICAL CONSISTENCY: retain identical head-to-body and limb proportions for each character between its two poses. Pose bends, no body stretching or squashing.
Koko blue monkey, peach ears/heart-shaped face, round red cheeks/chest heart, long blue arms, peach short legs, curled blue tail. BOTH poses same BLACK FILLED rounded triangle nose with short central stem joining rounded w-shaped muzzle EXACTLY as 365 surfing reference. Mouth may open below but nose must remain.
Gohanko white flared body, black side buns and fringe, ochre brimmed hat, black neck bib, red torso circle, yellow feet, circular blue rim bag at right hip. BOTH poses retain a clearly visible black OVAL NOSE between eyes and separate smile, like teaching reference. Nose never confused with mouth.
Bear brown rounded stocky bear, beige muzzle, black oval nose and angular brow, red cheeks, white lower garment with turquoise waistband.
Rabbit pink long ears, red scarf/simple pink paws, bilateral red wedge cheek marks, separate black forehead curl ABOVE eyes. BOTH poses keep a small solid black nose at centre of lower w-shaped muzzle BELOW eyes, as surfing reference. No cream belly patch.
Yauyau grey pointed hood, black oval face/white ring eyes/tiny white mouth, red floating ball, tapered legless body. ONE red neck band with EXACTLY TWO red scarf-arm branches, one left and one right, each ends in one hand. Top pose two arms open. Bottom one continuous left arm from left neck to magnifier hand; one continuous right arm from right neck to leaf hand. NO third scarf tail, NO dangling extra end, NO extra connection across chest or back. Both arms visually traceable.
Tree brown pointed grooved chestnut crown, pale peach face, round cheeks, pink petal neck collar, green ribbed body/mitten arms, short pink legs/black shoes. BOTH poses have the VISIBLE VERTICAL TERRACOTTA ROUNDED TRIANGULAR NOSE from the gym reference, above separate mouth. Never replace it with a tiny black dot. Preserve petal collar not wings.
Faces must follow reference feature construction, do not generically simplify noses away. Entire board thoughtfully hand-drawn, recognizable existing cast, spacious even layout.
